hints.fondue: Sit around a shared pot, spear a piece of bread on a long fork, dip and swirl it in thick melted cheese, and stretch the strings.
hints.lasagna: Show stacking many flat layers on top of each other, spread sauce and sprinkle cheese, then cut a big square and lift it out.
hints.pomegranate: Cut a round fruit in half, whack the back of it with a spoon over a bowl, and pick out tiny seeds to eat, staining your fingers red.
hints.cotton candy: Spin a paper cone round and round in a big bowl, collect a huge fluffy cloud, then pull off tufts and let them melt in your mouth.
hints.baklava: Show stacking many thin sheets, pour sticky syrup over them, cut little diamonds and eat one with sticky fingers, licking them clean.
hints.artichoke: Peel off leaves one by one, scrape each between your teeth, until you reach the heart in the middle.
hints.oyster: Pry open a tight shell with a small knife, slurp the contents with your head tipped back, and look for a pearl.
hints.stir-fry: Hold a hot wok, toss and flip lots of small things with quick wrist moves, stir with a spatula, with sizzling noises.
